fee_analysis.notes: Dated 2026-07-19 preliminary read-only Mantle mainnet sample: 101 consecutive recent blocks and 21 spaced points across 97,158,262–98,158,262 all showed baseFeePerGas=50 gwei and block gas limit=60,000,000 (evidence block 98121659 hash 0xc44bbf683065f56d14cfa1abf20fbdafdcc39e45e8071ea30e603a95228469ed). start_block_hash is the analysis-window identifier for block 97158262; end_block_hash is pinned to the documented evidence block. Current stability is not a permanent protocol constant; runtime must still consume live block-header base fee and gas limit at block ingress.

sampling_policy.description: Qualification samples are individual gasleft() measurements from Foundry EVM replay of the WHI-501 optimized runtime (GasProfileMeasure.t.sol) against mock pools, one sample per amountIn in a fixed 12-point grid. No synthetic arithmetic ramps. Deep V3 tick / Moe bin buckets cannot be produced by mocks and remain explicit Unsupported until a Mantle state-fork suite lands (docs/DEFERRED_ISSUES.md DI-10). Historical competitor receipts are research-only. Reverts excluded from limits.

route_key_definition: ordered_protocols+hop_count+optional(v3_tick_crossings,moe_bin_crossings); V3/Moe buckets required when protocol present; labels ticks={0|1-5|6-20|21+} bins={0|1-3|4-10|11+}
